types.definition: Pre-observation experiment, reliability, calibration, failure, resolution and reporting requirement declared as part of the scientific contract.
Worlds remaining compatible with realized observation y under the declared evidence/reliability requirement D_req.
Tuple/family of every response object required by the declared loss contract C_L over all contract-required actions, horizons, retained histories/mechanisms, and report distinctions.

hard_distinctions.rule: never identical; requirement is pre-observation contract architecture, evidence class is post-observation epistemic compatibility
not interchangeable unless the single summary is independently proved sufficient for every responsibility in C_L

operators.signature: ObservationRecord y x EvidenceRequirement D_req -> RealizedEvidenceClass E_y^{D_req}
operators.meaning: Produces epistemic compatible-world set without creating structural distinctions.

operators.signature: World omega x LossContract C_L -> FullLossContractResponseSignature Sigma_{C_L}(omega)
operators.meaning: Collects all loss-relevant response objects required by C_L.

operators.signature: ModelWorldUniverse Omega x FullLossContractResponseSignature -> LossGeneratingState Q_L
operators.meaning: Q_L identifies worlds exactly when their full loss-contract response signatures agree.

equations.realized_evidence: E_y^{D_req}={omega in Omega: omega compatible with y under D_req}

crest_alignment.required_resolution_closure_reading: C_{D,T} in v0.5 prose is canonically read as C_{D_req,T}, a pre-observation required resolution/reportability obligation.
crest_alignment.realized_evidence_separate: Realized evidence is E_y^{D_req} and is not an input that creates ontic distinctions.
crest_alignment.loss_state_equivalence: Q_L is isomorphic to the loss-specialized CREST RequiredState only when Sigma_{C_L} exhaustively encodes all distinctions required by C_L on the declared common carrier.

anti_upgrade_rules: Do not treat realized evidence E_y as a ScientificContract component.
Do not treat D_req as if it were an observed evidence class.
Do not call a quotient based on one convenient loss statistic LossGeneratingState unless sufficiency for the full loss contract has been established.
Do not infer WarningEvaluationState from LossGeneratingState unless warning response factors through the full loss-contract quotient.
Do not treat this clarification patch as new empirical evidence or a new standalone theorem family.
